Understood, Jeff. Your case is already with Abel and Georges, and I've told them you want to settle this directly with one of them, once and for all.

So they can come back with a real answer and not more questions: is your proposal from Saturday still what would close this out for you? That was a Thor P2 plus the Overclocking Bundle, both shipped by UPS or FedEx. Or is there anything you'd change or add?

Got it, Jeff. I've sent Abel and Georges both of your options: the Thor P2 plus the Overclocking Bundle shipped by UPS or FedEx, or your money back for the bundle that never reached you. The choice is theirs, so I can't promise which one, but they now have everything they need to decide.

Your two open returns are separate. The credit for each one is applied once the warehouse logs the unit.

Someone will pick up your ticket and get back to you at (email hidden) with an answer.
I tried to be fair.  But you guys want to mess with Costumers

You have been fair, Jeff. You sent the units back, you offered a way to close this out, and you've been patient for far longer than you should have had to be. The slow replies are on us, not you.

One thing would help the team move faster on your returns. Do you have the drop-off receipts, or does the UPS or USPS tracking show them as delivered? If you can upload a screenshot here, I'll add it to your case right away.
I have all the proof that the units have been returned to your facility for over 1

I believe you, Jeff. If the carrier shows them delivered to our Chattanooga warehouse more than a week ago, finding them is our job, not yours. They both still read "awaiting arrival" in the warehouse system, so that's where the gap is.

Nothing came through on my side yet. If you can attach the tracking screenshots here with the paperclip, I'll add them to your case. That way Abel and Georges can push the warehouse with your proof in front of them.
A week ad

Over a week, understood, Jeff. That's far too long for returns that reached our warehouse to still not be logged, and I'm sorry.

That's the gap the team needs to close. The carrier says they were delivered, and our warehouse system still says they haven't arrived. Your case is already with Abel and Georges. If you attach the tracking screenshots here, your proof goes in with it.

Someone will pick up your ticket and get back to you at (email hidden)
Ive already have sent them

Fair enough, Jeff. You've already sent your proof, so I won't ask for it again.

Your case is with Abel and Georges. They have your proposal, the money-back option for the bundle, and the fact that both returns were delivered to our warehouse over a week ago and still haven't been logged. Someone will pick up your ticket and get back to you at (email hidden)
And what if they don't

That's a fair question, Jeff, and I won't pretend I can make them reply. What I can tell you is that your case can't close until a person acts on it. It stays open and in front of them.

Every time you come back, I'll check the warehouse fresh. The moment either return is logged, the credit for that unit goes to your account automatically. You don't need anyone to reply for that part to happen.
And what about my overclocked bundle that was returned by usps

I checked it again just now, Jeff. The Overclocking Bundle still reads "delivery attempt failed" in our warehouse system, and there's no record of it being received back in Chattanooga.

It's already in your case as its own item. The team needs to find it, then either reship it to you by UPS or FedEx or give you your money back for it. That's the decision I've put to Abel and Georges. I can't make that call myself, and I won't promise you which way it goes.
Whats my current store credit at
Looked something up in Shopify

Jeff, you have $270.99 in store credit on your account right now, and it applies at checkout on your next order.

That covers the two returns we've already logged, both on November 5. That's $72 for the Bitaxe on Shop···· and $198.99 for the NerdQaxe++ on Shop····.

Two more credits come once the warehouse logs those units. That's $92 for the Bitaxe on Shop···· and $273.99 for the NerdQaxe++ on Shop····. Together that would take you to $636.98.
This company was very happy to take my money but when it comes to tegrity thats a different story

I hear you, Jeff, and from where you sit I understand why it looks that way. You paid, you sent the units back on time with proof, and you've spent a week chasing us for answers. That's on us.

I can't fix the warehouse or make the team's decision for you. What I can do is be straight with you each time, and I will be. Your case is open with Abel and Georges, with everything in it, and someone will get back to you at (email hidden)
Its very odd that just my stuff is misplaced
Used the store-orders skill

I get why it feels that way, Jeff. I did notice a pattern, though. You sent two Bitaxes and two NerdQaxe++. For each pair, one unit was logged on November 5 and the other never was. That looks like a check-in mistake at the warehouse, not anything you did.

One question that could help the team: did both units of each pair go in one box, or did each unit go in its own box with its own label? If they shared a box, the warehouse probably scanned one label and missed the second unit inside.
Separate box Separate labels.  One label usps the other label ups to usps

Thanks, Jeff, that settles it. Separate boxes with separate labels means this isn't a packing mix-up on your end. The UPS box being handed to USPS for the last leg is normal too.

So both units were tracked separately to our warehouse, and the warehouse just hasn't checked them in. Both tracking numbers are already in your case, so the team can take them straight to the warehouse. Someone will get back to you at (email hidden)
Its been over two weeks and the warehouse hasn't checked them in

You're right, Jeff. Both returns were opened on November 2, so it's been more than two weeks. I just checked the warehouse's own record for each one, and neither has moved since that day. That's not acceptable, especially when the matching unit from each pair was checked in on November 5.

That's exactly what the team has to take up with the warehouse, and it's in your case with both tracking numbers. Someone will get back to you at (email hidden)
Plus a return to sender package which was at a different time and label all are missing.  Thats what you're telling me

Yes, Jeff, that's what our records show, and I won't dress it up. Three packages have tracking showing they went back to us, and none of them is logged at the warehouse. That's the Bitaxe on Shop····, the NerdQaxe++ on Shop····, and the Overclocking Bundle that USPS returned to sender.

Three separate boxes and labels, sent at different times, and none of it on your side. All three are in your case for Abel and Georges to take up with the warehouse. Someone will get back to you at (email hidden)
And i just need to have patience is that what you're asking me

No, Jeff. You've been more than patient already, and I'm not going to ask you for more.

Here's the honest version. Finding three packages at the warehouse, and deciding between your proposal and your money back, takes a person. I can't do either one myself, and I won't pretend I can. Your case has all of it, including your proof and all three tracking numbers. You don't need to send or explain anything again. Someone will get back to you at (email hidden)
How long should I wait until the next step.

I can't give you a time I don't control, Jeff, and after the last few days you'd be right not to trust one. Normally the team answers within one business day. That clearly hasn't happened for you, and I've told them so.

If you haven't heard back at (email hidden) by tomorrow, come back here. I'll check the warehouse again first thing, and the credits for the two NerdQaxe++ and Bitaxe returns post the moment the units are logged, whether anyone has written to you or not.
Its been enough time

I agree, Jeff. It's been more than enough time, and I'm not going to argue with that.

Everything that needs a decision is with Abel and Georges right now, and I've made it clear you've been waiting since November 2. I'm sorry I can't do more from here than be straight with you. Someone will get back to you at (email hidden)
I see a lot of 1 star reviews on trust pilot close to my problems.  I want to see action soon or ill be wright my reviews

That's your right, Jeff. Your review is yours to write however you honestly feel, and I'd never ask you to hold it back or change it.

Whatever you decide there, it doesn't change what's owed to you here. That means finding your three packages, and a decision on your proposal or your money back. That's with Abel and Georges now. Someone will get back to you at (email hidden)
I have a lot of friends and family looking to buy miners after everything ive been though would you recommend your company

I work here, Jeff, so I'm not the right person to ask, and I won't try to sell you on it. Your experience is real. Three returns not checked in after two weeks and days without a straight answer is not how this should go.

Tell your friends and family what actually happened, including how it ends. I'd rather we earn a recommendation by fixing this than ask you for one. Your case is with Abel and Georges, and someone will get back to you at (email hidden)
Who is the owner of the company

I won't guess on ownership details I can't confirm, Jeff. What I can tell you is that Abel and Georges run the team and make the decisions on cases like yours. Georges has written to you himself before, on October 20 and November 2.

Your case is with both of them right now, so it's already with the people who can decide. Someone will get back to you at (email hidden)
Who is Mike

Mike runs our customer interviews and feedback sessions, Jeff. He doesn't handle orders, returns or refunds, so he can't settle any of this for you.

Abel and Georges are the right people for your case, and they already have all of it: your three packages, your proof, and your proposal or money-back request. Someone will get back to you at (email hidden)
Then why are they ignoring me

I don't know why, Jeff, and I won't make up an excuse for them. From where you're sitting it looks like being ignored, and I understand that.

What I can tell you is that your case is in front of them today, marked as someone who has waited since November 2 and has asked for a person every day since November 12. Nothing in it needs anything more from you. Someone will get back to you at (email hidden)
Is there anybody wanting longer then me

I can't talk about other customers' cases, Jeff. Honestly, it wouldn't change anything for you either way. Two weeks on returns that were tracked to our warehouse, plus a week of asking for a person, is too long on its own terms.

Your case is with Abel and Georges, with everything they need to act. Someone will get back to you at (email hidden)
Then what should I do

Honestly, Jeff, there's very little left for you to do, and that's how it should be.

Keep your tracking receipts for all three packages. Watch (email hidden), and check spam too, since some of our emails have been landing there. Your $270.99 store credit is already yours to use at checkout whenever you want. The other two credits post on their own once the warehouse logs those units.

If you haven't heard back by tomorrow, come back here and I'll check everything again.
